hero.title: Track Everything.
hero.body: Monitor your items on a schedule. Get instant alerts when status changes. A simple, focused tool that stays out of your way.

features.title: Everything you need to stay on top of your data
features.subtitle: One focused tool. No bloat.

monitoring.title: Automated Monitoring
monitoring.description: Set it and forget it. Your items are checked on a schedule and you are alerted the moment something changes.

alerts.title: Instant Alerts
alerts.description: Get notified the same day something changes. No more discovering issues days or weeks after they happen.

organize.title: Organize Everything
organize.description: Add tags, notes, and metadata to your items. Filter and search across your entire collection instantly.

digest.title: Weekly Digest
digest.description: Every week, get a summary of what changed, what is healthy, and what needs your attention.

insights.title: AI-Powered Insights
insights.description: Pro users get AI-powered analysis and recommendations based on their data trends.

reports.title: Monthly Reports
reports.description: Pro users receive a monthly summary report with trends, breakdowns, and historical comparisons.

add.title: Add your items
add.desc: Add items individually or in bulk. Include a URL, a label, and any notes you want to track.

check.title: We check them on a schedule
check.desc: Your items are checked daily (or hourly on Pro). We detect status changes and record the history.

alert.title: Get alerted instantly
alert.desc: The moment an item changes status, you get an email. Every week, you get a full digest of what is healthy and what is not.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.

cta.title: Start tracking in under 60 seconds
cta.body: Free plan available. No credit card required.
